$comment: Sinopia design tokens (place-based drawing app). Source of truth for every visual value; DESIGN_BRIEF.md gives the reasons.
Status: DRAFT. Load-bearing picks color.bg, font.display, font.body are aegis-default until the team confirms them (D-014).
No dark mode for the hackathon: the metaphor is plaster and paper, and artists judge their drawing colors against a light frame.

bg.$description: aegis-default: intonaco (lime plaster) grey sampled toward the plaster sinopie are drawn on; deliberately greyer and darker than the cream #F5F1E8-#FAF8F5 range that reads as a 2026 'tasteful default'. Confirm or replace.

surface.$description: brief(from color.bg): lighter plaster for panels (signature panel, results cells); kept grey, not cream (slop lint flagged #F4F2EE)

surface-raised.$description: aegis-default: white for anything that frames artwork (canvas border, fresco cards, preview sheet) so the artist's colors read true

surface-hover.$description: brief(from color.bg): hovered/selected rows and family tabs

text-primary.$description: aegis-default: warm lamp-black ink; 13.1:1 on bg

border.$description: aegis-default: 3.4:1 on bg so input and joint-handle outlines meet SC 1.4.11

accent.$description: ref: sinopia red-ochre, the product's namesake pigment (named color Sinopia = #CB410B), deepened to pass 4.5:1 as text on bg (5.0:1) and carry white text (6.6:1). Leads: primary actions (New, Publish), active nav, links.

accent-2.$description: ref: the named Sinopia color itself. MAP ROLE: pins for public frescoes and the 'drawing' end of the Reality↔Drawing slider. Never used for body text.

accent-3.$description: ref: spolvero, the charcoal pounce dots fresco painters used to transfer a design. MAP ROLE: clusters (ink blots with a count), the dotted Same Wall radius ring, the 'reality' end of the slider.

success.$description: brief(from color.accent-3): confirmations ('Copied') in spolvero charcoal with a check icon and text; no green, which with a light warm ground reads as the cream+sage default (lint finding 2026-09-26)

warning.$description: aegis-default: 'exact spot' publish warning, no-GPS notice; 5.3:1 on bg

danger.$description: aegis-default: destructive and hard errors only (Delete fresco, upload failed). Same hue family as the accent, so every danger use carries an icon and text; 7.1:1 on bg

focus-ring.$description: brief(from color.text-primary): ink outline, 13:1 on bg; red would vanish next to red skeleton lines

display.$description: aegis-default: a text serif with optical sizes and Renaissance book-face roots, matching the fresco lineage of the name; used for the wordmark, screen titles and fresco titles only. Not one of the 2026 'elevated serif' defaults (Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Playfair). Confirm or replace (D-014).

body.$description: aegis-default: a neutral humanist sans that stays legible at small sizes on phones (toolbar labels, license chips, coordinates); system-ui fallback covers place names in scripts Plex doesn't (e.g. 東京). Confirm or replace (D-014).

caption.$description: aegis-default: ratio 1.25 from 16px body; captions = license/attribution lines

control.$description: aegis-default: near-square; fresco panels and drawing boards are rectangles

draw.$description: aegis-default: the one signature move: a new pin is 'inked in' on the globe after publishing; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion

md.$description: aegis-default: reference panel switches from bottom sheet to side panel; viewer goes side-by-side
